basics.name: Zishang Xiang
basics.summary: Master's student at Beijing Institute of Technology and research assistant at Peking University, working on world models, embodied intelligence, and mobile robot navigation.

work.company: Peking University, School of Computer Science
work.summary: Working in Prof. Hao Tang's lab on world-model-based embodied policies for mobile robot navigation.
highlights: Action-conditioned world-model training and rollout consistency
Inference acceleration and deployment on mobile robot platforms

work.summary: Worked on VLA algorithms and application demos for dual-arm mobile robots.
highlights: LeRobot-based reproduction and optimization of ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmoLVLA, and PI-series methods
Distributed asynchronous inference system for robot applications

publications.name: MWM: Mobile World Models for Action-Conditioned Consistent Prediction
publications.summary: A mobile world model for action-conditioned consistent prediction and planning-based image-goal navigation.
